description: Session status on the clock (spec 019): waiting when Claude needs you, done when it finishes, cleared when you answer. Off, without starting Python, until the plugin's "Clock for session status" option is set.

hooks.command: [ -n "$CLOCK_HOOKS_URL$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_HOOKS_CLOCK_URL" ] || exit 0; P=python3; case "$(command -v python3)" in ''|*WindowsApps*) P=python;; esac; $P "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session_status.py" waiting

[ -n "$CLOCK_HOOKS_URL$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_HOOKS_CLOCK_URL" ] || exit 0; P=python3; case "$(command -v python3)" in ''|*WindowsApps*) P=python;; esac; $P "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session_status.py" done

[ -n "$CLOCK_HOOKS_URL$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_HOOKS_CLOCK_URL" ] || exit 0; P=python3; case "$(command -v python3)" in ''|*WindowsApps*) P=python;; esac; $P "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session_status.py" clear

[ -n "$CLOCK_HOOKS_URL$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_HOOKS_CLOCK_URL" ] || exit 0; P=python3; case "$(command -v python3)" in ''|*WindowsApps*) P=python;; esac; $P "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session_status.py" clear
